title.narrative: Secondary Green Cities Development Project

description.narrative: The project will demonstrate economically competitive, environmentally sustainable and socially inclusive development for Vinh Yen city (Vinh Yen), Hue city (Hue) and Ha Giang city (Ha Giang) of Viet Nam. The project cities' green and climate resilient development approaches will be scaled up for nationwide green secondary city development in Viet Nam.

Progress Toward Outcome: Loan 3590/3591: Recruitment of safeguards monitoring consultant was completed with the contract signing on 30 June 2021. By the end of March 2025, 5 out of 8 CW contracts were signed. Particularly, construction works for packages VY-CW02/VY-CW03/VY-CW05 were completed and are under preparation for handover, while works under VY-CW01 and VY-CW04 are ongoing. ADB and Vinh Phuc's Department of Construction have already provided NOL on the NBS and green features enhancement for the DED of the ICB package, VY-CW11 (Green designs package). The procurement of this VY-CW11 is suspended due to the Government loan closing date (LCD) documented as 30 June 2023 and Vinh Phuc PPC's decision to revise the master plan of the Dam Vac Lake.Grant 0550: The original grant closing date (GCD) was 31 December 2022. VPMO submitted a request for a grant extension to MOF and was advised that, according to the Investment Policy (IP), the original LCD had expired on 30 June 2023. MOF will request the extension for the grant and the loan once Vinh Phuc approves the revised IP for the loans. The revised IP for the loan was approved on 9 April 2025. Loan/grant closing date: As discussed earlier, the original closing date indicated in the Investment Policy (IP) for the SGCDP loans/grants was 30 June 2023. The revised IP (ie, extension of loan closing date and proposed additional works) was approved by Vinh Phuc People's Council on 9 April 2025. The overall revised FS is anticipated to be approved by PPC in June, and the MOF's request is expected to be sent to ADB in August/September 2025

Status of Implementation Progress: Vinh Phuc subproject: The contract was awarded in December 2022. Progress is about 25%. DOC approved DED. ADB provided NOL on green features in June 2023. In April 2025, PPC decided to amend the master planning of the Dam Vac lake, which caused a significant change to this particular package area, resulting in the submission of the revised FS for approval. DOC approved DED. ADB provided NOL on green features in June 2023. In April 2025, PPC decided to amend the master planning of the Dam Vac lake, which caused a significant change to this particular package area, resulting in the submission of the revised FS for approval.WWTP progress is 90%. Equipment installation for the WWTP is suspended due to pending loan extension. Works were completed at the end of Q4/2023 pending liquidation, as the Grant closing date was 31 Dec 2022. The VPMO is coordinating with MOF to extend the grant closing date until 31 December 2023 to settle all pending liquidation. Achieved. 95 government officers were trained, of which 32 are female (33.7%)Achieved. 61 VPMO staff attending various training courses of which 33 are female staff, making up 54.1%
Hue subproject 21.9km/21.9km Completed of drainage sewer pipes- Ke Van River: completed 1.1km/2.5km - Dong Ba River: completed 0.043km/ 0.043km - Lap River: completed 1.2/1.2km- An Cuu River: completed 0.57km/0.57km - Nhu Y River: completed 0.650km/ 0.650km - An Hoa River: 0/5km not commenced yet (submitting to the Ministry of Construction to adjust the basic design)Achieved.530 households have been connected to the clean water source of the water supply system for the Phu Son waste treatment areaAchieving 99.4% of construction completion. Construction is underway to complete 17.1 hectares of green park.0.1 ha has not been handed over due to problems with Ho's family, located 7.2 km out of 7.2 km being constructed..Completed 02 bridges (Long Tho bridge and Kim Long bridge)/05 bridges (3 bridges under construction: Vi Da bridge, Nhu Y river bridge and the connecting bridge from Pham Thi Lien street to Le Duan street)7 severely affected communes/wards (communities) were selected and invested in works and non-works intervention. All works were completed, handed over, and put into operation.218 officials, of which 30 are female staff, were trained (The baseline requires 75 government professionals, in which at least 33% women or 24 female participants)Achieved.93 government staff, of which 38 female (40.9%) were trained on project management, safeguards and social and gender aspects and GAP For the training activity, the project has implemented 5 training courses for project staff as well as other related staff with on safeguards policies, monitoring and evaluation, financial/contract management, community supervision... within the scope of HU-CS01 Consultant. 142 staff members from PPMU, Departments, People's Committees of wards/communes, and contractor representatives were trained, of which 48 are female, accounting for 33.8%. Under Community-led Initiative component, the HU-CS03 consultant and the contractor had also conducted 185 training sessions/classes on 4 topics (Community-based Disaster Risk Management; Communication on Epidemics and Environmental Sanitation; Disaster Response Skills; Extracurricular on Climate Change and Disaster Risk in Schools) for 5,163 attendants, with a female ratio of about 60.3% (3,113 attendants). Not yet achieved. The original bidding process was canceled due to the absence of a qualified bidder. The PMU is updating the DED and drafting the BD for re-bidding. Not yet achieved19 Government professionals (4 female, 21%) attended the training. Achieved. 104 government staff, 51 female (49.03% women) received training. Procurement Training: VRM provided general procurement and e-procurement training during the Inception Mission (20-21 Nov 2018) and 8-9 Jan 2019. Not yet achieved.
Ha Giang subproject: CW01 this package was on a post-review basis, and its original scope was to construct 13 sewer lines. However, due to the very high cost re-estimated during the DMS stage, the land acquisition cost was extremely high compared to the estimated initially, and the contract could not be awarded, even after the bid evaluation result (BER) was completed. The updated FS was re-approved to reduce to 6 sewer lines. The revised PP will be approved by the end of Apr 2025, and the draft BDs will be submitted in June 2025. Not yet achieved-1km embankment and landscaping west of Lo river (CW04): Contract signed but construction has not yet commenced due to revision of DED, updating cost estimate and compensation plan. After the storm events in 2024 with extremely high rainfall intensity caused severe flooding in Ha Giang city, PPC has recently required the Department of Agriculture and Environment (DAE) to reassess and identify any potential negative impacts that may be caused if the sections are embanked in the downstream Lo River. - 3km embankment and landscaping of the Mien river (CW06): progress at 21%.- 1.6 km embankment of the south and landscaping of the Me river (CW05): The updated FS, followed by DED, was re-approved in November 2024 after ADB had no objection to enhancing green design features. The advertisement for this package is expected in December 2025, and the contract award is expected in Quarter 1/2 2026. Not yet achieved- 2.1 km Phung Hung road (CW07): is 95% completed. Handover is expected in May-June 2025.- 2.9 km of the southern ring road (CW03): Contract was awarded. Construction commenced: 11%- 1.2 km of the National highway 2 and bridge works (CW02): The construction site was handed over in Oct 2023. Construction progress at 14%
